regions.label: Solid blue title bar with 'Clash (Mihomo) ↔ Link Converter' title, supported-formats subtitle, language and theme icon buttons
Left column: 'sing-box Config' heading with Paste/Copy, Config Type radio group, Open File/Load URL/Download toolbar, JSON textarea, 'To Node Link' convert button
Right column: 'Node Links (One per line)' heading with Paste/Copy, Open File/Load URL/Download toolbar, links textarea, 'To sing-box Config' convert button

evidence.note: Multi-line textarea for sing-box JSON config, outlined, scrolls internally
Multi-line textarea for node links, placeholder 'One node link per line (ss:// vmess:// vless:// trojan:// etc.)'
Radio group selecting config format; switching relabels left panel
Ghost button opening a file picker to load config text into the textarea
Same for node links panel; 'Load URL' reveals an inline URL field + fetch button
Convert action transforms text locally; not a labelled-field form submitting structured data
JSON shown in a plain textarea: no syntax colouring, gutter or folding
Two side-by-side columns but fixed width, no divider/resize
Language button toggles EN/中文 directly on click, no menu opens

structure.layout: single-screen utility tool: full-width blue title bar, centered 1200px container with two equal side-by-side panels (input ↔ output) each with header actions, toolbar, textarea and full-width convert button; footer pinned at bottom

aesthetics.typography: Segoe UI throughout (Microsoft Fluent UI v9 defaults): bold title in header, semibold section headings and buttons, regular body/textarea text, small 12px toolbar ghost buttons
aesthetics.typeScale: 32px bold app title; 24px semibold panel headings with 12px muted parenthetical; 16px semibold convert buttons; 14px body, inputs and Paste/Copy buttons; 12px toolbar and footer

notes: Built with Fluent UI React v9 (Segoe UI, #0f6cbd brand, 4px radii, 1px #d1d1d1 outlines). Two mirrored panels with bidirectional convert buttons (→ To Node Link / ← To sing-box Config) carrying arrow icons. Header has only icon buttons (language toggle switches EN↔中文 instantly; theme toggle). 'Load URL' reveals an inline URL input with fetch and close buttons above the textarea rather than a modal. Textareas are fixed ~400px tall and scroll internally; capture is stretched to 5400px so most of the canvas is empty #fafafa. No navigation, no marketing content.
